plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for A10 load balancer. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, chassis temperature, fan speed and status, power supply status, and interface traffic, for Thunder ADC / AX series (enterprise PEN 22610).
name: Loadbalance

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Average CPU utilization of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance (A10-AX-MIB axSysAverageCpuUsage, last 5 seconds, 0-100 percent). Sustained high CPU means the ADC is near its processing capacity.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total system memory of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance in bytes (A10-AX-MIB axSysMemoryTotal, reported in KB and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used system memory of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance in bytes (A10-AX-MIB axSysMemoryUsage, reported in KB used and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: System memory utilization of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance, computed as used/total*100 (A10-AX-MIB axSysMemoryUsage / axSysMemoryTotal).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Physical system temperature of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance in degrees Celsius (A10-AX-MIB axSysHwPhySystemTemp scalar).

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Rotation speed of chassis fans 1-3 of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance (A10-AX-MIB axSysHwFan1Speed/Fan2Speed/Fan3Speed scalars), one series per fan.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Fan status of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance (A10-AX-MIB axSysFanStatusTable axFanStatus, some hardware models only), normalised so that okFixedHigh/okLowMed/okMedMed/okMedHigh = 1 (normal) and failed/notReady = 2 (fault); rows reporting unknown(-1) are dropped and not counted as faults.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Status of the lower and upper power supplies of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance (A10-AX-MIB axSysLowerPowerSupplyStatus / axSysUpperPowerSupplyStatus scalars), normalised so that on(1) = 1 (normal) and off(0) = 2 (fault); a supply reporting unknown(-1) is dropped and not counted as a fault.
